newReleases.name: Storm Born Kicker Bolt N Ball
newReleases.desc:
A mysterious accident changes everything. While driving through the city, our hero gets caught in a sudden crash. But instead of ending his journey, the accident awakens an incredible power within him the power of electricity!

Now, a simple ball is no longer just a ball. With every powerful kick, it can travel at lightning speed. Guided by a skilled trainer, master your new ability and prove that lightning can turn an ordinary kick into an unstoppable shot.

Swipe your finger across the screen to draw the perfect path for the ball. Aim carefully, control your direction, and let the player kick the ball with electrifying force. Score goals, overcome challenging obstacles, and use your lightning-powered kicks to complete each level on the road classes.

The journey takes place across dynamic city roads, where every level brings a new challenge. As you progress, the difficulty increases, demanding better aim, faster reactions, and smarter use of your special power.

newReleases.name: 三國幻想錄:開局送5星關羽
newReleases.seller: Guangzhou Neon Information Technology Co., Ltd
newReleases.desc:
黃巾亂起，朝野動盪，大漢江山分崩離析。天下豪雄趁勢而起，諸侯割據四方，戰火蔓延城郭鄉野。梟雄懷吞併天下之志，義士抱匡扶社稷之心，無數武將謀臣登場，譜寫一段段可歌可泣的亂世傳奇。在這風雲變幻的時代，你將作為一方勢力的掌權者，招攬四海豪傑，籌劃軍策，征戰四方，書寫屬於你的三國霸業。

離線掛機躺收資源，告別爆肝刷本；抽中新武將即可直接上陣，無需耗費資源重複培養。打破品質束縛，所有武將皆可突破至無雙境界，無論蓋世名將，或是冷門文臣武吏，只要是你心儀的角色，都能成為隊伍核心主 C。

【幻想亂世・群賢匯聚】
百餘位三國武將經過全新美術演繹，魏、蜀、吳、羣四方豪傑盡數登場。於酒館邂逅各路名將，解鎖武將專屬傳記，窺見英雄背後不為人知的故事，沉浸式感受波瀾壯闊的漢末風雲。

【離線放置，輕鬆征伐天下】
主線闖關全自動戰鬥，離線掛機持續產出金幣、裝備、各類養成素材。上線一鍵領取全部累積收益，利用碎片化時間就能實力進階。閒暇之餘掛機養成，空閒時間調整隊伍陣容，無需耗費大量時間反覆刷關。

【策略佈陣，自由搭配陣容】
不局限傳統強力國家隊，高自由度陣容隨意組合。武將羈絆連攜、神兵秘寶、戰魂加持、站位博弈，不存在一套通吃全關卡的萬能隊伍。依據敵方陣容靈活調整武將，無損切換隊員，巧謀克敵，以智謀決勝沙場。

【多元玩法，飽覽三國風華】
闖關試煉、秘境探險、跨服演武、群雄擂台、軍團混戰等豐富內容。PVE 闖關尋覓絕世寶物，PVP 與全服玩家同台角逐；加入軍團與盟友同心協力攻伐城池，豐厚獎勵全軍團成員皆可共享。

【良心養成，拒絕無謂內卷】
武將裝備、等級、星階一鍵轉移，培養錯武將也不用從頭再來。低品質武將同樣可以培養至畢業強度，零氪、微氪玩家也能搭建心儀的強力隊伍。隨心組建你的幻想三國軍團，縱橫中原，成就亂世霸業。

newReleases.name: Clapback: Rhythm Boss Fights
newReleases.desc:
Every star in the night sky was once a note in a song. Then the Hush ate the singing, and the stars went out.

Ten bosses hold the stolen song. Each one beats out a rhythm, and you tap it back. Get it right and the stars come home. Miss a beat and you lose a heart.

THE CLIMB
Fight your way up the Spire, one boss per floor, each with its own song. The rhythms start on the beat and build, floor by floor, to rests, eighth notes and syncopation. Earn up to three stars on every floor, and stack combos for bigger hits.

TRIALS
Four arcade challenges, each with its own badge:
• Deadeye: tap the instant the spark hits the mark
• Quickdraw: wait out the feints, then strike on the real tell
• Shatter: tap fast enough to break five seals
• Blackout: answer the call while your help goes dark, one layer at a time

PRACTICE
Pick any song you've reached and play its call and response, with no boss and no hearts to lose. Turn off the rhythms you already know and drill the rest. Every session is saved.

Every boss you beat and every Trial tier you clear earns a card. Clapback is free, and any support purchase unlocks sharing them.

No ads. No accounts. No data collected. Plays offline.

newReleases.name: Mosaica: Relaxing Puzzles
newReleases.desc:
Find a little calm, piece by piece.

Mosaica is a picture puzzle game built around a simple, satisfying idea: bring matching neighbors together and watch them become one. Drag the pieces into place, connect the right edges, and move joined pieces as a group until the complete picture comes to life.

DISCOVER 250 BEAUTIFUL PUZZLES
Explore a collection of richly detailed scenes, from peaceful nature and colorful cities to imaginative worlds, cozy corners, and remarkable sights. Complete each level to unlock the next picture.

CONNECT, GROUP, COMPLETE
Every correct connection brings you closer to the finished scene. Connected pieces stay together, so each move can bring a larger part of the picture into place. Easy to understand and rewarding to complete.

ENJOY YOUR OWN PACE
Take a short puzzle break or settle in for another level. There is no countdown to beat. See your time and move count on the results screen, then continue your journey or replay a completed puzzle.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your completed levels are saved on your device. Return to your next puzzle from the home screen, see your progress, and revisit pictures you have already unlocked. No account is required.

MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME
Choose a light or dark appearance, or follow your device theme. Play in 14 languages: English, Turkish, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

A beautiful picture is waiting on the other side of every puz

newReleases.name: Verdant Orbit
newReleases.desc: Enter a mysterious dimension in Verdant Orbit, a futuristic, 3D-inspired puzzle game where every move brings you closer to the exit. Guide your glowing energy orb through 15 challenging missions, collect every crystal, navigate around obstacles, and reach the portal to unlock the next dimension. Plan your movements carefully, explore unique puzzle layouts, and test your problem-solving skills as the challenges become more difficult. Enjoy glowing visual effects, intuitive directional controls, progressive level unlocking, and haptic feedback options. Verdant Orbit is designed for offline play, so you can enjoy the puzzle adventure without an internet connection. Can you collect every crystal and complete all 15 dimensions?

newReleases.name: Hug the Dot
newReleases.desc:
Stay on the dot.

A dot wanders across the screen, a little faster every second. Touch it. Stay on it. The moment you lose it, the run is over. Your score is the time you hold on, multiplied by what you picked up on the way.

One input. No menus to fight. Retry in a heartbeat.

HOW IT PLAYS
- Press and hold the dot and follow it wherever it goes.
- Pickups appear around the arena. The dot collects them as it passes, so stay on it while it does. Double your multiplier, grow the dot, slow it down, or take a risk with a shrink or a burst of speed. Each pickup has its own shape, so colour is never the only clue.
- Lose the dot and the screen floods with colour and your score. Right away you can watch the replay of exactly where you slipped: the dot's path, your finger's path, and the spot where you let go.

A DAILY COURSE FOR EVERYONE
Every day has one course that is the same for every player. Finish a run and see your rank, and a live "N got this far" count while you play. Reach 100 seconds and you are embraced: the run carries on, and you are counted among the players you outlasted. Beat the best anyone has managed today and the pill turns gold: NEW WORLD RECORD.

SAME COURSE, BETTER YOU
Retry replays the same course with a ghost of your best run, so you can see where you were faster. New dot gives a fresh course and a fresh colour. Every course has a short code you can type in or share with a friend.

DETAILS
- Plays in portrait or landscape; the arena fits your screen
- Neon

newReleases.name: Cat Lift: Cozy Elevator
newReleases.desc:
Welcome to Cat Lift, a cozy elevator puzzle about helping a building full of little neighbors get home.

Tap an elevator door to collect waiting cats, then choose where to take them next. Each cabin has its own seats and stops. Big cats need two seats, and nobody skips the queue.

A good route does more than travel up and down: clear the front of a queue, leave room for the next pickup, and turn a homecoming into a new ride. As the neighborhoods unfold, cabin capacities change and both lifts can have different routes.

- Explore 72 puzzles across nine illustrated neighborhoods.
- Start with 24 free puzzles in three complete neighborhoods.
- Unlock the remaining 48 launch puzzles with one permanent purchase.
- Plan around three, four and five floors, changing stops and cabin combinations.
- Meet ginger, silver tabby, and round calico neighbors.
- Find shorter routes and keep your personal best.
- Undo, retry, and ask for a hint whenever you need one. These stay free.
- Play offline with progress saved on your device. Purchasing and restoring need an internet connection.
- No ads, subscriptions or background music. Sound effects and haptics can be switched off.

There is no countdown. Take your time. Everyone deserves a cozy homecoming.

The full-game purchase unlocks the six remaining neighborhoods; puzzles still open as you progress. Restore purchases is available in Settings and in the full-game shop. Progress stays on each device and does not synchronize across devices.

newReleases.name: Political Timeline
newReleases.desc:
Presidents change. Your party endures.

In Political Timeline, you are the power behind the party. Choose Democrat or Republican, pull the strings from behind the scenes, and decide how far you’ll go to keep your coalition alive.

Every swipe is a decision. Back a policy, confront a scandal, bargain with Congress, or take a chance on an adviser whose motives are questionable. Keep workers, the middle class, the economy, and the elites on your side—because winning an election means little if your party falls apart.

CAMPAIGN FOR EVERY VOTE
Your campaign choices influence voters across the country. Watch election-night results arrive as you compete for the presidency, the Electoral College, the House, and the Senate.

LEAVE YOUR MARK
Work toward policies through connected events, watch Congress vote, and navigate a changing Supreme Court. Follow your party’s legacy through a timeline of laws, court decisions, and elections.

FIGHT YOUR WAY BACK
Losing office doesn’t end your story. Rally your supporters, challenge the governing party, and build a comeback. Staying in power and winning it back call for different choices.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED
Face corruption, international crises, strange conspiracies, and a cast with plenty of personality. Some advisers want to save the country. Others want influence. The goose has demands of his own.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH
Explore branching storylines, discover hidden achievements, and keep separate campaigns in three save slots.

How long can you

newReleases.name: STOP MIX
newReleases.desc:
The letters are scrambled. Can you put them in order before time runs out?

STOP MIX turns scrambled words into a challenge of thinking, speed and fun. Use the category as a clue, then build the answer by tapping tiles or dragging each letter to its place.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Solo Mode: choose 1, 3 or 5 minutes and solve as many words as you can.
• Group Mode: gather 2 to 6 players around one phone. Solve quickly, earn the time bonus and pass the device.
• Three difficulty levels: Family, Adult and Challenge.
• Choose your favorite categories or mix all the topics.

EASY TO LEARN
Tap to place a letter. Tap an answer tile to return it. Drag between answer spaces to swap pieces. Answers are checked automatically: if yours is wrong, rearrange the letters while the clock keeps running.

MORE WORDS, MORE CHALLENGES
More than 2,000 playable words in each language: Portuguese, English and Spanish. Words do not repeat within the same game. In Group Mode, continue with accumulated scores or finish after a full round.

TURN YOUR SCORE INTO A CHALLENGE
Track your solo bests and share an image of your result to challenge friends: can anyone beat it?

• Play offline.
• No ads and no account required.
• Separate music and sound effect controls.
• Pause and resume your game.
• Progress and preferences stored on your device.

newReleases.name: Color Bloom Chain
newReleases.desc:
Welcome to Color Bloom Chain, a relaxing yet challenging color puzzle game where every move matters!

Match the Colors
Move flowers between hanging vines and bring the right-colored leaves together. Complete a flower by making all its leaves the same color.

Untangle the Vines
Grab the vines from the right spots and move them beneath other vines to create the perfect chain. Plan your moves carefully, one wrong move can make the puzzle much harder.

Watch Them Bloom
Once a flower’s leaves are completely matched, it disappears and makes room for your next move.

Simple to Learn, Challenging to Master
Easy controls make Color Bloom Chain accessible from the first level, while increasingly complex vine arrangements put your puzzle-solving skills to the test.

Can You Clear Every Flower?

Move. Match. Complete. Bloom!

newReleases.name: Silkada
newReleases.desc:
A screen, an ink, a pull of the squeegee. Watch your print take shape.

Silkada is a puzzle game set in a 3D screen-printing workshop. Study each reference image, choose your screens and inks, and discover how to recreate the artwork one layer at a time.

Every layer changes the result. Experiment with colors, work out the printing order, and try again until the pieces come together.

FOLD THE PHONE. OPEN THE PRESS.
On iPhone Duo, the physical fold becomes part of your workshop. Choose a screen, close the device to lower it onto the paper, select your ink, and pull the squeegee. Open the device to lift the screen and reveal your new layer.

The workshop adapts to the inner and cover displays. You can turn fold-to-print on or off in Settings.

INSIDE THE WORKSHOP
• Solve 30 printing orders in Season 01.
• Choose screens, inks, and the order of your layers.
• Pull the squeegee with a touch gesture.
• Unlock color separation, ink mixing, screen exposure, and screen washout challenges as you progress.
• Keep your finished prints in a local collection.
• Meet Jorge, the workshop cat.

START WITH FIVE FREE ORDERS
The first five orders are free. A single, non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks orders 6–30 of Season 01. No subscription. Workshop challenges unlock as you advance through the campaign.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
No account required. Your progress and collection are saved on your device. Play unlocked content offline; an internet connection is needed to load purchase informa

newReleases.name: Pitch&Dice: Football RPG
newReleases.desc:
Pitch & Dice plays a football career like a tabletop role-playing game. You walk into the academy at 16; at every key moment you roll a d20, and your choices write your story all the way to your farewell match.

• Every moment is a roll: d20 + stat bonus against your opponent's die. A natural 20 is always a critical success, a natural 1 always a disaster.
• Pick your class: Striker, Playmaker, Centre-back or Goalkeeper, then one of 16 specialisations that shapes your signature moment and style.
• A season map: league games, cup nights, derbies and the final; every month brings new forks, transfer offers and event cards.
• Bond with teammates, unlock combos, earn the coach's trust and settle the score with your nemesis.
• Legacy: every retired career joins the Honour Roll and gives the next one a small head start.
• Scenario of the Week, Daily Drill, 49 achievements and Game Center leaderboards.
• 21 languages, plays offline.

Our fair-play promise:
Your first career is completely free, start to finish. Unlimited Careers is a one-time purchase: start as many new careers as you like and play three side by side. Cosmetic packs only change the look. No paid dice advantage, no loot boxes, no subscription, no in-game currency. Dice, odds and stats are the same for everyone.

The universe is fictional: no real players, clubs or leagues.

newReleases.name: Atlas Ahoi
newReleases.desc:
Last night, Gustav, a gourmet bookworm with a monocle, ate every single name off the world's greatest atlas. ("In my defence, Liechtenstein was extremely crunchy.") Now the map is blank: borders, coasts, and not one name. That's where you come in.

Atlas Ahoi is a comic adventure-map geography game. Spot a glowing country and name it, find it on the map, type it from memory, and match the capitals. Every right answer inks a country back onto the map, until the whole world is yours again.

• 197 countries on 6 continents, in 21 chapters
• Capitals for every country, plus 37 great rivers in 5 river chapters
• Four tiers: Scout (pick), Pathfinder (tap), Cartographer (type), Capitals
• German and English, switch anytime. Typing accepts both, and small typos are forgiven
• Stars, explorer ranks and Gustav's tasting notes on every bite
• No timers, no lives, no game over
• For iPhone and iPad, with a dedicated layout for the big iPad screen

Free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no data collected. Works offline.

Maps: Made with Natural Earth.

newReleases.name: Airshift: Flying Car Rhythm
newReleases.desc:
The flying car, to the beat of the music.

Airshift is a one-button rhythm game. Your car drives itself to the beat, and you tap to jump, switch sides to drive on the ceiling and hold to fly. Every obstacle lands on the rhythm: hit the timing and the soundtrack grows.

THREE MODES, ONE BUTTON
• Road: tap to jump. Hold and the car jumps again as soon as it touches the ground.
• Suction: every tap switches between the floor and the ceiling.
• Flight: hold to climb. Flying uses air, and the blue rings refill the tank.

Portals change the mode mid-level, and gravity portals flip the road over: upside down, you jump down.

12 LEVELS, EASY TO INSANE
From the Test Track at 120 BPM to Orbit at 150 BPM, through a beach at sunset, a firefly forest, a canyon, the polar aurora, a city watched by drones, a storm and the stratosphere.

THE MUSIC ANSWERS YOU
The soundtrack is played live, together with the level. Jumps and side switches play notes from the current chord, and every jump on the beat lights up a new layer of the music.

PRACTICE UNTIL YOU MAKE IT
In practice mode, drop checkpoints and replay the hard part as often as you like. Stuck? Watch the path: the car shows you the way through.

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD
Every completed run scores rhythm points: perfect taps are worth more, and a streak on the beat multiplies up to 4x. Your best run on each level goes on the global leaderboard, per level and overall. No sign-up: you get a randomly drawn pilot name.

GARAGE
Six colors for you

newReleases.name: Galstna | جلستنا
newReleases.desc:
Galstna — Baloot the way it is played at the table.

Play Saktna by the rules you already know: Sun and Hokum, buying and bidding, projects and Bloot, Double, Three, Four and Gahwa, and the Kaboot. Scoring works exactly as it does around the table, down to the half-point rules everyone argues about.

• Solo — play a full game against the computer, offline.
• Rooms — create a room and invite your friends with a code, or join theirs.
• Learn — a step-by-step tutorial for beginners: card order, buying, projects, and how points are counted.
• Arabic and English, with multiple themes.
• No ads.

Built mobile-first, with a proper right-to-left Arabic interface and every font bundled inside the app, so it works with no connection.

newReleases.name: Battle De Streams
newReleases.desc:
Tu connais vraiment tes artistes ? Prouve-le.

TITRE MYSTÈRE — Chaque jour, un titre à trouver dans le genre du jour (Rap US, Pop FR, Afro…). 8 essais et des indices : artiste, écoutes, année, classement. Partage ta grille sans rien dévoiler. Pas rassasié ? Le mode À volonté t'en donne autant que tu veux.

CITEZ-EN 9 — Par équipes, sur un seul téléphone. Un artiste tombe : citez 9 de ses titres en 60 secondes. Les tubes rapportent 1 point, les titres de vrais fans jusqu'à 5. Attention aux pièges : un featuring ne rapporte rien, il coûte.

LES ENCHÈRES — Combien de titres peux-tu citer en 45 secondes ? Annonce, surenchéris… puis tiens ton pari. En ligne contre un ami ou un adversaire au hasard, avec classement et ligues de Bronze à Diamant. Ou En soirée : deux équipes, un seul téléphone.

LE MATCH — De 2 à 5 joueurs. Chacun cite un titre de l'artiste tiré au sort : le plus gros compteur d'écoutes gagne la manche. Seul ? Lance la Survie : enchaîne les artistes avant la fin du chrono, de plus en plus vite, et complète ta Discothèque.

- Aucun compte à créer : un pseudo et c'est parti
- Ajoute tes amis avec ton code ou un lien
- Gagne des disques d'or en jouant
- 14 genres : rap FR, rap US, pop, afro, latino, années 80 et bien d'autres
- Gratuit, sans publicité

Battle de Streams est un jeu indépendant, sans lien avec les artistes, les labels ou les plateformes d'écoute.

newReleases.name: Trixie: Cat Sort Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Trixie is a ginger cat who loves knocking things off shelves. Your job? Tidy up after her before she makes another mess!

SORT IN THREES
Drag items between shelves and match three of a kind. When the front of a shelf is empty, the items at the back come forward. Think a few moves ahead and earn three stars.

5 ROOMS, 100 LEVELS
Kitchen, playroom, bathroom, garden and bedroom. Every room adds a new twist: yarn that tangles items, foam that hides what is underneath, a crate locked with a key, and Trixie dozing off right on the shelf.

A WARDROBE FULL OF OUTFITS
Stars earn you fish, and fish buy hats, outfits, extras and beds. More than 50 items to collect, from a crown and a wizard hat to a tuxedo and butterfly wings.

22 PETS
Cats, dogs and exotic friends, each with their own personality and lines.

FOR EVERYONE
• short levels for a break, the bus or a queue
• plays offline
• keep your progress with your Apple account and move it to a new phone
• 6 languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French and Italian

The game is free and contains ads. Extra pets, wardrobe items and fish are available as in-app purchases.

newReleases.name: Gürbüz: Bahçe Cezası
newReleases.desc:
Gürbüz yakalandı. Ceza: bahçe temizliği. 10 bölüm, her birinde zil çalıyor.

Parmağınla yön ver, yaprakların üstünden geç, vakum hepsini çeksin. Torba dolunca konteynere koş, boşalt, aurayı topla. Zil çalmadan bitirmen lazım.

SINIF ARKADAŞLARIN İNTİKAM PEŞİNDE
• Nabi torban doldukça peşine düşer, iter, yapraklar saçılır.
• Berk topladığın yığınları tekmeler.
• Erbil temizlediğin yere çuvalla yaprak döker.
• Karşı hamle: vakum ağzını değdir, şapkasını kap. Zile 10 saniye eklenir.

CEZA KARNESİ
Ön bahçeden müdür odasının önüne 10 bölüm. Her bölümde üç yıldız. Kaldığın yerden devam et, eski bölümlere dönüp rekorunu kır.

MAĞAZA
Topladığın aurayla torbayı büyüt, emişi güçlendir, hızlan. Bölümden önce güç seç: +15 saniye, turbo, kalkan. Gürbüz'e yeni şapka al.

KOMBO VE ŞAPKA KULESİ
Yaprakları durmadan çek, kombo büyüsün, ödül gelsin. Kaptığın her şapka Gürbüz'ün kafasında kuleye dönüşür.

Torbayı büyütmeden ileri bölümleri geçmek kolay değil. Bitirmek marifet.

Gürbüz serisi: 01 · Suç, 02 · Ceza, 03 · Ağır Ceza.

newReleases.name: Gürbüz: Sınıfın Canavarı
newReleases.desc:
Sınıfın en fırlama öğrencisi Gürbüz iş başında.

Hoca tahtaya yazarken kâğıt topu fırlat, arkadaşlarını vur, aurayı topla. Ama dikkat: hoca her an dönebilir. Bakışı yere kırmızı düşer; kâğıdın oradan geçerse yandın.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Parmağını geri çek, bırak. Kâğıt uçar.
• Hoca dönünce dur. Tebeşir sesi kesildiyse dönmek üzeredir.
• Seri atış ses yapar, şüphe dolar. Sabır aura getirir.
• Hocaya değersen direkt kırmızı. Hoca sinirle sırana gelir.

7 DERS, 7 HOCA
Matematikten İngilizceye her ders bir öncekinden zor. Sahte dönüşler, ani dönüşler, açık pencereden rüzgâr, koridorda müdür, ön sırada ispiyoncu. 4. derste tüftüf açılır: düz, hızlı, sessiz.

DERS PROGRAMI VE YILDIZLAR
İstediğin derse gir. Barajı geç, bir yıldız. Barajın üstüne çık, iki yıldız. Hiç yakalanmadan iki katını topla, üç yıldız. 21 yıldızın hepsi marifet ister.

MAĞAZA
Topladığın aurayla kâğıt stoğunu büyüt, daha hızlı yırt, daha sessiz at. Dersten önce güç seç: Af, Hazırlık, Uykulu Hoca. Gürbüz'e yeni şapka al.

Gürbüz serisi: 01 · Suç, 02 · Ceza, 03 · Ağır Ceza.

newReleases.name: NadeBook Base
newReleases.desc:
Record the grenades and abilities you throw, sort them by map and site, then rehearse them before queue. It starts empty and works offline.

BROWSE BY MAP
- Open any CS2 or VALORANT map
- Filter by side, site, utility type and difficulty
- Tag lineups as live or archive and hide outdated ones

FOUR FRAMES PER LINEUP
Each entry holds a map position, a stand spot, an aim reference and the result. Add your own screenshots or leave a frame empty and use the built in schematic view. Notes cover where to stand and aim.

FAVORITES AND SQUAD PACKS
- Star the throws you rely on
- Group them into a pack for a default execute
- Share a pack as text or a pack code
- Import a teammate's pack code

PRE MATCH DRILL
Build a deck from all lineups, favorites, one pack or one map. Reveal each frame step by step, mark whether you nailed it, then retry the misses. No account, no ads, no purchases.
